items.text: New disease: diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, in two topics: untreated (34 studies) and relapsed/refractory (28 studies).

The Prognosis tab now covers smoldering and relapsed myeloma as well: risk models, biomarkers and response measures linked to the trials that used them, two new relapsed-myeloma entries (t(11;14) and venetoclax; early relapse) and three new markers to watch.

Long-term follow-up and final overall survival results added to 36 trial cards across the lymphoma and myeloma topics, for example TRIANGLE at 4.5 years, CARTITUDE-1 at 5 years, and final survival in POLLUX, CASTOR and ALCYONE.
Relapsed follicular lymphoma: long-term CAR-T results added (ZUMA-5 at 5 years, median PFS 62.2 months; ELARA; TRANSCEND FL at 3 years) and 2026 EHA guideline placements on the trial cards.
Relapsed myeloma: two new phase 3 trials, teclistamab alone (MajesTEC-9) and talquetamab-daratumumab with or without pomalidomide (MonumenTAL-3), both improving PFS at early relapse.
New on newly diagnosed myeloma: a Prognosis tab with risk models, biomarkers and MRD measures (9 new entries, linked to the trials that used them) and Markers to watch.
